correctness.rationale: For all integers k>=2 and budgets B>0, the centered variance decomposition gives the universal budget lower bound V_k; the scalar F_k derivative determines the k<=3 versus k>=4 phase. The exact weight formulas satisfy sum rates V_k. On leaf fluctuations, the spectral gap certificate is a+kc>=1; on quotient increments it is the 3x3 M matrix with kernel (d,1,1), nonpositive off-diagonal entries, and a proved sum-of-squares ground-state identity. Equality yields lambda2=1; the simplex-coordinate eigenvectors and complementary slackness force every edge weight, proving global uniqueness. The explicit verify.py ran k=2..60 (59 values) and checked budget/gap/multiplicity/PSD. These finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result is an exact all-orders design theorem for a natural rate-budgeted diffusion/consensus network: it identifies when an entire family of available clique edges is optimally extinguished and when all those rates switch on, with closed-form rates, unique global optimizer, exact mixing rate, and spectral degeneracy transition. This is a structural boundary of a motivated convex network design problem, not a small numerical improvement or arbitrary invariant.
